_doc: Source-of-truth for the 'Recently added' rail on /glossary/ (EN+ES). Edit this file when a new term lands; scripts/inject-glossary-recent.mjs reads it and stamps the rail between <!-- glossary-recent:start --> sentinels in glossary/index.html and es/glossary/index.html. Order is newest-first; only the first `display_count` entries render. Term slugs must exist as directories under glossary/ (the script verifies and skips orphans).
